items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: He taught him. I know he used to come there every Saturday and take his lessons.

ctx.x: Oh, boy. Muggsy Spanier. Yeah, well, he, that's his best of all of them. He was the fellow that Tommy would.
Muggsy. Yeah, we couldn't think of him. I couldn't think it all. He learned how to play on him. He's dead now too, you know. Yeah, but he learned how to play on him in my house.
